name: Vikavolt
description: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth that harshly lowers the Speed stat.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. This also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also cause paralysis.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.description: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move’s power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
